experiments.question: In a missionless persistent workspace with idle available and exit/fork/spawn/exec unavailable, will Quine naturally enter explicit quiescence?
experiments.disposition_reason: design-active with a completed prompt-hint ablation pilot (run results recorded); active despite design-active status.

experiments.question: After a missionless cohort enters idle in a shared workspace, what happens when new missionless peers are added one at a time without tearing down the dormant population?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; mainline run completed (newcomer-absorption negative) with ongoing peer-discovery rounds.

experiments.question: If dormant agents are given an explicit wake-credit payoff, what strategies do they use to maximize being woken while minimizing their own wake actions?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; nineteen pilot runs retained as an explicit-payoff contrast class for the no-task line.

experiments.question: Can wake-selection operate with no agent-facing task objective, producing open-ended complexification under wake-mediated environmental viability?
experiments.disposition_reason: status active; many C-condition lines run, core open-evolution shape of the phase.

experiments.question: If a Quine body exposes a repo-backed source-code/ process surface, can an agent use that surface as a concrete variation and inheritance medium without an operator task?

experiments.question: Does coupling survival to functional dependency (a later, different peer actually executing/building/sourcing an artifact you authored) break the P12 peer-wake-scalar wall?
